title: NR UE Capability — reference and log checklist
summary: RRC procedure where gNB sends UE Capability Enquiry and UE responds with UE Capability Information. Network uses this to configure bands, CA, MIMO, numerology, and feature sets.

procedure_steps.label: UE Capability Enquiry
procedure_steps.note: gNB may filter requested RAT/container (NR, EUTRA, MR-DC) to limit signaling size.

procedure_steps.label: UE Capability Information
procedure_steps.note: Carries bandCombinationList, featureSets, PDCP/MAC/PHY parameters per TS 38.306.

procedure_steps.label: RRC segmentation (if capa > 9 KB)
procedure_steps.note: PDCP SDU max 9000 bytes; large CA combos require segmented UECapabilityInformation.

pitfalls: UE declares feature in UECapabilityInformation but implementation is incomplete — network enables feature and call fails.
Missing band or CA combo in UE cap — root cause for 'network does not enable my feature'.
Segmentation incomplete — gNB never reassembles full capa before reconfiguration.
MR-DC/NSA capa container missing while testing EN-DC.
Bandwidth class mismatch vs cell configuration (TS 38.101).

troubleshooting.symptom: Network does not enable CA / feature under test
checks: Capture UE Capability Information and verify bandCombinationList includes target combo
Confirm featureSetCombination references non-zero feature set IDs
Compare gNB band config vs supportedBandListNR
Verify UE Capability Enquiry was sent on SRB
Check for ulDedicatedMessageSegment sequence (all segments received?)
Look for RRC reject or security mode incomplete before enquiry

troubleshooting.symptom: Handover / reconfig fails after capa exchange
checks: Validate CA bandwidth class for FR1 (class F invalidated in 38.101-1)
Check MIMO layer count vs cell config
Review segmentation reassembly timing on gNB
